episode_title: $100M+ TEAM INTERVIEW | Building Partners, Not Dependent Agents with Carin Nguyen

real_qa.q: Why did Corinne Nguyen reduce her Phoenix real estate team from 72 agents down to 44 agents?
real_qa.r: Corinne intentionally shrunk her team because Zillow lead flow had built a team of dependent agents rather than partners. She recognized that the dependency model was not sustainable and made a deliberate decision to rebuild with a focus on recruiting and developing true partners who bring their own value and commitment to the team, rather than agents reliant solely on lead generation.
real_qa.requete: Corinne Nguyen team reduction 72 to 44 agents why

real_qa.q: How did Corinne Nguyen transition from selling 900 REO listings solo to building a real estate team?
real_qa.r: After selling 900 bank-owned listings by herself from 2008-2011 as an REO-focused agent, Corinne realized the foreclosure market would not last forever. Her coach advised her to adopt clients from past transactions into her database. She then started recruiting agents within a brokerage she had created, eventually closing that brokerage in 2014 to focus entirely on team building, starting with 8-10 core agents.
real_qa.requete: Corinne Nguyen 900 REO listings transition team 2014

real_qa.q: What was Corinne Nguyen's Phoenix team's transaction volume and sales in 2025?
real_qa.r: In 2025, Corinne Nguyen's Phoenix team closed 696 transactions for $346 million in volume. This metric was tracked after she reduced her team size from 72 agents to 44, demonstrating that the team maintained significant production despite the intentional downsizing.
real_qa.requete: Corinne Nguyen Phoenix team 696 transactions 346 million 2025

real_qa.q: What recruiting process does Corinne Nguyen use to attract agents to her team?
real_qa.r: Corinne uses a two-phase video-based recruitment process: first, video texts and drip campaigns showcasing team wins and training content to interested prospects, followed by a prerecorded webinar that looks live highlighting team benefits. The second phase is a one-on-one conversation with a recruiter to discuss expectations, splits, and deeper details. She separates benefits conversations from expectations conversations and uses Corded to identify seasoned agents most likely to make a move.
real_qa.requete: Corinne Nguyen agent recruiting process video text webinar

real_qa.q: What is Corinne Nguyen's ideal agent profile for recruitment?
real_qa.r: Corinne's favorite type of agent is 'lightly seasoned'—someone with 6 to 36 months of experience who has not run out of money and has shown consistency in the industry. These agents are savvy enough to understand basic operations but not jaded like 15-year veterans; they are grateful for team support and more coachable than brand new agents who may seek opportunities elsewhere.
real_qa.requete: lightly seasoned agents 6 to 36 months recruitment

guest.bio_context: Corinne was once the number two agent in the entire country, selling 900 bank-owned REO listings by herself between 2008-2011. She founded her real estate team in 2014 after closing a brokerage she had created, transitioning from individual production to team building and business operations. She is recognized as a top producer in Phoenix and has been featured in Gary Keller's mastermind at Keller Williams, receiving the Pinnacle Award for recruiting.
